scope: warm in-memory comparison of whole-map processing against chunked/partial processing of one synthetic town map already resident in memory; not a disk, streaming, or real game-asset benchmark

map.source: horizon.town_map.make_town_map (original synthetic map, ORAS town-route inspired layout, not derived from or containing actual game assets)

settings.order_policy: per repeat, swap execution order of each measured pair (whole-map vs. chunked) by repeat index parity: even repeats run whole-first, odd repeats run chunk-first; applied independently to the encode pair, the decode/reconstruct pair, and the region-retrieval pair
settings.region_schedule_policy: deterministic schedule of grid chunk indices built from cyclic random permutations (numpy Generator.permutation) of the shared seeded rng, generated once per chunk_size before the method loop and reused unchanged for every codec method; each full cycle visits every grid chunk exactly once
settings.container_format: private benchmark container, not a production format; the index parser below trusts its own just-built output and performs no adversarial validation (no bounds/overflow checks on offset or length, no checksum) because it only ever parses data this module itself produced, never untrusted input
settings.scope: in-memory warm benchmark only; no disk or engine I/O measured
